main.description: The Placita account's list of known Explore authors: the accounts whose Public places guests see in Explore and on the shared place pages. Kept by the Placita account; readable by anyone.

dids.description: The authors' stable account identifiers (DIDs), in the order they were added. The Placita account itself is always shown and does not need to be listed here.

createdAt.description: When the list was first written.
